title: 1:1 prep - Avery Brooks
content:
Goal: quick sync to unblock feature work, coaching, and alignment on priorities for next two sprints.

Meeting context:
- 30 min 1:1. Focus: unblock PRs, review oncall cadence impact, career check-in (IC ladder), and next quarter goals alignment.
- Last 1:1 (2026-02-05): agreed Avery would lead KV cache perf spike, finish draft RFC for session-shard routing.

Agenda (proposed):
1) Quick wins / wins since last 1:1 (3-4 min)
2) Current blockers & ask (8-10 min)
3) Oncall load + rotational fairness (5 min)
4) Career / growth: IC ladder, mentoring opportunities (7 min)
5) Action items & next steps (2-3 min)

Notes to self / prep points:
- PR #879 (serving-runtime): Avery is waiting on infra review (cc: Priya). Check if merging requires canary infra change INF-427. If so, coordinate with release-engineering.
- KV cache perf numbers: Avery reported 18% p90 reduction on local bench but still seeing tokenization mismatch in prod traces. Ask for exact trace ids and sample prompts.
- Oncall: Avery flagged two long pagers last week; they feel three incident responses in one week is heavy. Discuss temporary rebalancing and whether we need extra SRE support during upcoming infra migration (Mar 10-20).
- Career: Avery asked about path to Senior IC (expectation: owns subsystem + mentor, reliable delivery). Prepare concrete feedback examples and short growth plan.

Wins (to call out):
- Finished draft of session-shard routing RFC ahead of schedule - good cross-team collaboration with infra.
- Improved unit test coverage on caching layers (increase from 58% to ~72% for module).

Blockers / asks from Avery (from Slack thread + DM):
- Blocking: infra review on PR #879 (owner: Priya Shah). Need clear merge timeline.
- Blocking: missing perf traces for post-quantization behavior; Avery needs access to prod-sampled traces from Feb 10-17 (SRE).
- Ask: guidance on prioritizing KV-perf vs model-migration work for Dedicated customers next sprint.

Suggested responses / prompts for the meeting:
- "What's the absolute minimum we need from infra to merge #879 this week? Can you list the three things and owners?"
- "For the perf traces, can you share 3 representative sample traces and the commands you used to reproduce locally?"
- "If we had +1 SRE for two weeks during the infra migration, which tasks would you offload to them?"

Career / growth (prepare):
- Strengths to call out: ownership of session-shard RFC, cross-team communication, pragmatic tradeoffs on batching.
- Gap areas: broader roadmap influence (needs to present proposals earlier), measurable impact on platform SLAs (needs more ownership of SLO metrics).
- Concrete next steps: 1) Own rollout plan for session-shard routing (owner: Avery) with milestones and success metrics (due: 2026-03-21). 2) Mentor rotation: pair Avery with a junior engineer for 6 weeks on caching module (start: 2026-03-08). 3) Present a 10-min proposal at eng-all-hands about KV caching tradeoffs (target: 2026-04-02).

Oncall / capacity discussion points:
- Current rotation shows Avery had 3 incidents in last 4 weeks. Check schedule fairness (pull rota spreadsheet).
- Ask whether short-term rebalancing (swap with Marcus Li for two weeks) would work - get Avery's preference.
- Long-term: propose moving high-noise alerts into lower-tier automated escalations; ask Avery for specific noisy alerts (INF-412).

Draft action items (will confirm in meeting):
- Samir: ping Priya for infra review on PR #879 and get explicit timeline; due 2026-02-23.
- Avery: share 3 prod traces + reproduce steps for KV perf; due 2026-02-24.
- Priya: if INF-427 is required for canary infra changes, list required infra changes and approve rollback plan; due 2026-02-25.
- Avery: write rollout milestone doc for session-shard routing with success metrics and a rollback plan; due 2026-03-21.
- Samir + Avery: propose oncall swap with Marcus (if Avery agrees), update rota; target decision by 2026-02-26.
- Avery: start mentoring pairing with junior (confirm mentee by 2026-03-05).

Follow-ups from last 1:1 (status):
- RFC for session-shard routing: draft complete, sent to infra for comments (status: awaiting infra review).
- KV cache perf spike: bench improvements locally, still need prod trace validation (status: in_progress).

Preparation checklist for the meeting (what I should bring):
- PR links and review checklist for #879.
- Recent incident list with timestamps (for oncall fairness discussion).
- Concrete examples of Avery's impact for career feedback (3 examples).
- Quick note on available headcount or temporary SRE support window.

Potential risks to surface:
- If PR #879 blocks past Mar 1, session-shard rollout timeline slips into Q2 and may impact Dedicated customers scheduled for March capacity.
- Overloaded oncall without rebalancing could cause burnout; propose short-term mitigations.

Tone notes: be candid but supportive on career path; focus on removing blockers first; prioritize measurable outcomes.

Later follow-up (post-meeting template):
- Quick summary email to Avery with agreed action items + owners + due dates.
- Add session-shard rollout milestones to the eng roadmap doc and tag release-eng.
- If swapping oncall, update rota and notify SRE.

"Parking lot" items (if time/next 1:1):
- Discuss public speaking coaching for Avery's all-hands presentation.
- Review potential talk topics for upcoming infra conference.

End of notes.
